links.comparator_used: Single models: source-only transfer logistic regression and target-only logistic regression
links.outcome: Discrimination (AUC) and calibration (Brier) on the Virginia hold-out set
links.effect: Meta-ensemble AUC 0.728 (95% CI 0.691-0.764), Brier 0.193 (95% CI 0.180-0.207); source-only AUC 0.725, p = 0.454; target-only AUC 0.628 (p < 0.001)
links.quote: Source-only transfer performed similarly (AUC 0.725), with no significant difference (p = 0.454), and both outperformed target-only logistic regression (AUC 0.628; p < 0.001).

links.comparator_used: source-only transfer to Virginia without target adaptation
links.tradeoff: Disparities persisted; not all complex target-adapted methods improved discrimination (Enhanced MAML AUC 0.677 did not improve over naive transfer).
links.quote: Fairness analyses showed lower race/ethnicity equalized odds differences for target-adapted models (0.132-0.157) than source-only transfer (0.897), though disparities persisted.

design_hint: local recalibration and transfer learning adaptation
